---
name: Development or research task
about: Agree on a platform change, experiment or model handoff
title: "[Task] "
---

## Goal

Describe the behavior or research question. Link the relevant roadmap stage.

## Deliverable and owner

What will be delivered, who is taking it, and which files/interfaces are affected?

## Acceptance criteria

List the checks or reproducible experiment that will establish completion. Include data split, opponent and budget for comparisons.

## Dependencies and handoff

Identify prerequisite tasks. For a model, include its ID, setup instructions, checkpoint location/hash and evaluation status. For an interface change, state the proposed observation/action/reward contract.
